decks.notes: The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while developing a strong board presence through efficient and aggressive creatures. It utilizes a combination of hand disruption, counter spells, and removal to control the game and protect its threats. The creature base consists of high-impact threats that can quickly close out the game, such as Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf. The deck also includes card draw spells to ensure consistency in drawing into key pieces. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, with a mix of dual lands and fetch lands to support the deck's color requirements.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly with Cloudpost and Urza's Tower, allowing for powerful threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger to be played early. It also includes disruptive spells like Bojuka Bog and Karakas to control the opponent's graveyard and creatures. The deck aims to ramp up its mana production to cast big threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan with removal and disruption spells. It combines ramp and control elements to dominate the late game and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with efficient creatures and spells. The deck utilizes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will to control the board, while also using cards like Fatal Push and Murktide Regent to remove threats. The tempo aspect comes from cards like Brazen Borrower and Nethergoyf, which can quickly close out games. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and utility. The mana base is efficient with fetch lands and dual lands to ensure smooth gameplay.

The main concept of this Reanimator combo deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with key creatures using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm, then bring them back into play using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also utilizes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect its strategy, while including powerful finishers like Murktide Regent and Archon of Cruelty to close out the game. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card draw and filtering, while Cling to Dust helps to manage the graveyard. This deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful reanimated threats.

The main concept of the deck is to generate infinite mana using cards like Basalt Monolith and Grim Monolith, combined with cards like Voltaic Key and Manifold Key. This enables the player to cast spells like Mystic Forge and Tezzeret, Cruel Captain, which in turn allow for manipulating the library, generating more value and potentially winning the game in a single turn. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Pithing Needle and Soul-Guide Lantern to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while also having alternative win conditions with cards like The One Ring and Glaring Fleshraker.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling a game-winning combo using various spells and creatures to mill through the entire deck, ultimately leading to either casting Thassa's Oracle or Dread Return to win the game on the spot. This combo is supported by a collection of fast mana sources, disruption spells, and recursion tools to ensure consistency and protection. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its explosive gameplay and win condition, prioritizing speed and efficiency to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on using various spells like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead to quickly bring powerful creatures like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath, Murktide Regent, and Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield from the graveyard. It also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disruptive spells, leveraging the graveyard as a resource to generate a strong advantage and win the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing the graveyard as a resource to quickly bring powerful creatures back into play, often circumventing traditional casting costs. By utilizing cards like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead, the deck can quickly bring out powerful creatures such as Murktide Regent, Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and Archon of Cruelty. It also includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will to protect its combo pieces. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Brazen Borrower and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to provide additional value and versatility. The deck also runs Wasteland to disrupt opponent's mana base.

Utilize land ramp and control elements to lock down the opponent's resources while generating significant value through land synergies and card advantage. Use cards like Exploration, Crop Rotation, and Life from the Loam to quickly assemble powerful land combinations like Thespian's Stage and Dark Depths. Control the board with cards like Maze of Ith and Wasteland, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Pithing Needle. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent by leveraging the powerful land capabilities and controlling elements available.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful board presence quickly through efficient mana ramp with cards like Mox Opal and Lotus Petal, while generating card advantage with Mishra's Bauble and Thoughtcast. It utilizes creatures like Cori-Steel Cutter and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to apply pressure on the opponent, supported by disruptive spells like Force of Will and Pithing Needle. The deck's synergy with artifacts allows it to consistently present threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan, ultimately aiming to overwhelm them with a fast and aggressive strategy.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures with powerful abilities that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. It also includes disruption in the form of discard spells like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck uses a combination of removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Goblin Bombardment to clear the way for its creatures to attack. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's aggressive strategy while also providing access to different colors of mana for the various spells in the deck.

This deck revolves around using various spells like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead to quickly bring powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier from the graveyard onto the battlefield. The deck includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Daze to protect the combo pieces from opposing removal spells and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base combines fetch lands, dual lands, and utility lands like Wasteland and Undercity Sewers to ensure consistent mana production for casting spells and activating abilities.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty, Murktide Regent, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier through cards like Entomb and Reanimate. It also includes disruption cards like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Daze to protect the combo. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps dig for combo pieces, while Brazen Borrower provides additional disruption. The deck also includes some creature beatdown potential with Barrowgoyf. The key strategy is to cheat big creatures into play from the graveyard early in the game to overwhelm the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish early board presence and disrupt the opponent with tempo plays. By utilizing efficient threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Delver of Secrets, as well as disruption spells like Daze and Force of Will, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and apply pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes tools like Wasteland and Stifle to further disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain its own advantage on the battlefield. Overall, the key strategy is to deploy threats, disrupt the opponent, and close out the game quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through a combination of countermagic, removal, and card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy using cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares, while also generating card advantage through Brainstorm and Preordain. The inclusion of cards like Dress Down and Prismatic Ending provides versatile answers to a variety of threats, while threats like Murktide Regent and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student help close out the game. The deck also has a slight emphasis on mana denial with the inclusion of cards like Magus of the Moon.

This deck uses the synergy between Phyrexian Dreadnought and Torpor Orb to control the board and shut down opponents' strategies. It includes a variety of control spells like Swords to Plowshares and Force of Will to handle threats, while also utilizing cards like Brainstorm and Ponder for card selection. The deck aims to disrupt opponents' game plan and establish a dominant board presence through powerful synergies and efficient removal spells. The inclusion of Urza's Saga also adds versatility and additional threats to pressure opponents.
